Mizensir says Alberto Morillas writes formulas by hand in his laboratory and that the brand's perfume production is in Geneva.
Mizensir's official interview states that its perfume production is in Geneva and its candles are produced in Switzerland in the company's own offices.
Geneva Tourism lists the Mizensir boutique at Rue Verdaine 4, 1204 Genève, Switzerland.
BDK Parfums' official Maison page identifies the brand as a Parisian perfume house founded in 2016 by David Benedek.
BDK Parfums' official biography identifies founder David Benedek as born and raised in Paris.
BDK Parfums' official legal notice identifies Parfums BDK (SAS) and lists its registered office at 312 rue Saint-Honoré, Paris.
BDK Parfums' official company information lists its Paris address at 312 rue Saint-Honoré.
BDK says its fragrance components are conceived, designed and developed in France within its creative studio; the source does not give a separate studio city.
records.open: Paris is the house/legal base, but the cited source only locates the creative studio at country level.

records.text: BDK says each olfactive creation is developed through dialogue between founder David Benedek and the perfumer, with components conceived and developed in France.
BDK states that its fragrances are made in France, using French partners and supply chains.

BDK states that its fragrances are assembled in the Cosmetic Valley of France.

Miller Harris' official contact page identifies MILLER HARRIS FRAGRANCES LTD (company number 12849282) and lists its registered office as 6 New Street Square, London EC4A 3BF.
records.open: The current Companies House register lists the same company number at 86 Fetter Lane. The website's registered-office address conflicts with the official company-register address; both claims are retained pending resolution.

records.text: Maison Bagian describes itself as the first Vietnamese perfume brand. This is the brand's own origin description; the source also describes a Vietnamese–French cultural identity.
The brand says its fragrances are perfected in Grasse with professional perfumers based there. This supports a Grasse formulation/perfumer-development relationship, not a legal base.

Maison Bagian states that its fragrances are produced in Grasse, France, and describes its production as using exclusive formulas. This is a brand claim; independent factory evidence was not located in this pass.

The company's official LinkedIn profile says the perfumery began in 1852 and identifies its headquarters in Makkah. The official company contact page independently lists its public administration address in Makkah.

The official company contact page lists Public Administration in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, and gives the company's commercial registration number. This establishes a stated administrative contact location, not necessarily every operating site.

The Saudi Food and Drug Authority lists Abdul Samad Al Qurashi Sons Factory for Perfumes and Cosmetics as a licensed cosmetic manufacturer in Jeddah (license ML-2023-CM-0130; expiry 2027-08-31). This supports a Jeddah manufacturing facility for the named company; product-by-product scope is not stated.

records.text: Swiss Arabian says it was established in 1974 as the first perfume house in the UAE.
The brand's official FAQ states that all Swiss Arabian fragrances are made in the UAE. It does not identify a specific factory or emirate.
Lattafa describes itself as established in the United Arab Emirates and as a third-generation family-run fragrance business.
Lattafa states that its process includes in-house manufacturing and describes its products as made in the UAE. No specific factory city is stated on the cited pages.
NISHANE describes itself as an Istanbul-based niche perfume brand. This establishes its stated base, but the cited page does not establish manufacturing or formulation location.

The current owner traces the brand's roots to Claus & Schweder, described as Portugal's first soap factory, in Porto; Achilles de Brito joined the company in 1903 and became a partner in 1908. This records the historical Porto origin without implying that every current product is made there.
KORRES says Giorgos Korres founded the company in 1996 after developing products through his Athens pharmacy.
KORRES describes its product formulation as being carried out in-house by its R&D team in Greece.
KORRES says it produces products in its own facilities and describes the brand as born and made in Greece. The cited material does not give the production plant's city.

An independent profile of the Danish B Corp identifies Skandinavisk as founded in 2012 and associated with its Copenhagen flagship; a specialist brand-history profile identifies Copenhagen as the place it began. This is secondary-source evidence, not a direct legal-registration record.
records.open: The cited B Corp profile confirms the Danish company and Copenhagen flagship; the precise founding city is stated by a secondary specialist profile at https://www.selezio.com/brands/skandinavisk.

records.text: The B Corp profile lists Skandinavisk SR ApS in Denmark and identifies its Copenhagen flagship store. The location is treated as a commercial presence, not proof that all operations are based there.
JANUA identifies WERIN WEALTH INTERTRADE CO., LTD. as its registered company and lists its address in Mae Suai, Chiang Rai, Thailand.

A specialist fragrance guide identifies LOE (Life On Earth) as a Seoul fragrance brand founded in 2019. This is secondary-source evidence; the brand's own site describes its lifestyle-fragrance identity but does not state a founding city.

Shilla Duty Free product records identify Cosmecca Korea Co., Ltd. as manufacturer and South Korea as manufacturing country for specific LOE 50 ml perfumes. This is product-level retailer evidence and should not be generalized to every LOE SKU without checking its label.
records.open: Product-specific manufacturer evidence; confirm each variant/lot separately before treating as brand-wide.

L'Artisan Parfumeur states that Jean Laporte founded the house in 1976 and describes its heritage as uniquely French savoir-faire. The cited source does not name a founding city.
The Fragrance Foundation France lists Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle at 21 rue du Mont Thabor, Paris. This supports a Paris commercial/contact base, not manufacturing or formulation.

Acqua di Parma's 2026 official editorial traces its origin to Parma: Baron Carlo Magnani created the first Colonia in 1916, drawing on his roots and life in the city. This supports Parma as the house's origin, not necessarily its current manufacturing location.
